name: empty-state
title: Empty State
description: Placeholder for missing or filtered results with glyph, title, description, and optional action.

api.description: Placeholder for missing data or empty filtered results. Compose a glyph, title, optional description, and optional action.

props.name: glyph
props.description: Decorative mark above the copy. Hidden from assistive tech.

props.name: action
props.description: Optional recovery control under the copy.

props.name: announce
props.description: When true, sets role="status" so assistive technology announces the empty state as it appears. Keep false for a static empty illustration that is part of the initial page.
